Package com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim

Class LimelightSimDevice

java.lang.Object
com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim.LimelightSimDevice
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class LimelightSimDevice extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Registers the simulated camera as a HAL SimDevice so it shows up on its own in the "Other Devices" panel of WPILib's Sim GUI.

No GUI code is needed: the Sim GUI groups devices by name prefix, so every camera this feature creates lands under the Limelight node, just like CTRE's CANMotor:TalonFX[n].

Outside simulation SimDevice.create returns null, so the whole class becomes a no-op without having to scatter conditionals everywhere.

Inspecting and forcing from tests


 var sim = new SimDeviceSim("Limelight:limelight-front", 0);
 double tx = sim.getDouble("tx").get();
 sim.getBoolean("Force No Targets").set(true); // simulates losing sight of the tag

    • update

      public void update(LimelightFrame frame, LimelightNTInputs inputs)
      Dumps a frame into the device's fields. It is called in the same place and at the same rate as LimelightNTPublisher.publish(com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim.LimelightFrame, com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim.LimelightNTInputs), so the Sim GUI and NetworkTables never show different cycles.
      Parameters:
      frame - the already translated frame.
      inputs - the inputs read this cycle.
